 CBS Sets ‘Fire Country’ Season 5 Finale Date
 Meredith Jacobs 
 November 16, 2026, 10:00 am 
 Comments 
 Eike Schroter/CBS 
 What To Know
 CBS has set its midseason schedule.
 Fire Country Season 5 only consists of 13 episodes, which means its finale will air early on in 2027.
 Fire Country is one of the CBS shows with a shorter episode order (13) for the 2026-2027 season, and so that means that when the network’s midseason schedule starts in 2027, it won’t be around for long.
 The series starring Max Thieriot is currently on a short break, returning with new episodes (the seventh of the season) on Friday, December 11. The midseason finale will air the following week, on December 1. Then, it returns from the holiday hiatus on Friday, January 8, 2027. The Season 5 finale has been dated for Friday, February 5.
 The following week, there will be a change to the Friday night schedule.  Sheriff Country , which has been airing at 8/7c since its debut last season, will move to  Fire Country ‘s time slot of 9/8c ( Boston Blue remains at 10/9c). Beginning February 12, kicking off the night will be  Einstein , CBS’ new drama (with comedic tones) starring Matthew Gray Gubler (back on the network after 15 seasons of  Criminal Minds ) and Melissa Fumero .
 Sergei Bachlakov/CBS
 With  Sheriff Country continuing to air after  Fire ‘s finale (and its season consisting of 20 episodes), TV Insider did ask the shows’ executive producers if we will continue to see crossover between the two , with  Fire characters appearing on the spinoff, at that point.
 “I would count my lucky stars if we could persuade one Max Thieriot to come visit us,” Matt Lopez said. “I would love to [bring Fire  characters over after its finale]. What we are all about, whether it’s  Fire Country ,  Sheriff Country , or the show we’re presently calling  Edge Med  [which is only in development so far], it’s about creating a seamless tapestry and a seamless universe. And the idea that we could be in the meet-up in an episode of  Sheriff Country , and Eve [Jules Latimer] could walk in, or Manny [Kevin Alejandro] could walk in, or Bode could walk in, is a big part of the fun. So we’ll definitely be looking for those opportunities for sure.”
 Related 
 'Sheriff' & 'Fire Country' Crossover: Morena Baccarin Talks Mickey & Manny's Bad Timing 
 Added Thieriot, “I think that’s really one of the keys to the franchise, is that these shows all exist in the same small town. And I think that’s one of the really fun things that we like to play with and really make it feel like when you go to Edgewater, you could see anybody, you could bump into anyone. …Obviously, there’s plenty of drama that comes with living in a small town, let me tell you, but it’s the fun of it, too. It’s just how interwoven everybody can be and is inevitably. And these people specifically, not just in their personal lives, but in their work lives. So yeah, I think we’re all kind of excited to have a little window of time where we can bring in and not be worrying as much about schedules and everything else.”
 Fire Country , Season 5 Finale, Friday, February 5, 9/8c, CBS
